page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-180 is a general-purpose server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 180 dedicated vCPUs derived from 90 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor, utilizing simultaneous multithreading with 2.0 threads per core. The system is equipped with 720.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The processor includes a cache hierarchy consisting of 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. This instance does not include integrated local storage or GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, as demonstrated by stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core metrics. Memory performance is similarly strong, with small-block cached read-only memory bandwidth and large-block uncached write memory bandwidth both ranking in the top 10%. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration, which contribute to top-tier performance in Passmark CPU extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests. Single-core performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% across Geekbench and stress-ng single-core tests.

While the instance excels in multi-threaded execution, software compilation, and ray tracing, certain single-threaded operations such as gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression perform at average levels. For language model execution, the instance achieves top-tier prompt processing and text generation speeds for medium and large models, though text generation for smaller models remains average. The high resource density of 180 vCPUs and 720 GB RAM offers high qualitative cost efficiency for consolidated workloads. This profile is suited for large-scale database operations, software compilation pipelines, static web serving, and CPU-based LLM inference.
